preconditions: Strict typed values;complete trusted caller snapshot;no client-supplied authority;known policy versions.
postconditions: Deterministic complete result or typed refusal;no effects or posting authority.
Business refusal returns Validation.ok=false with ordered code/field/message errors;invalid context or version fails without a Validation result.

authorization.rationale: Facts are trusted caller inputs,not product endpoint claims;pure ok grants no authority.

boundaries.rationale: Exact values,full-width identity,context completeness and rule version gates.

concurrency.rationale: No shared state;actual transactional snapshot/revalidation remains caller obligation.
